end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Used examples including cricket stumps, crease, letters and a slide.
Om identified direction as the difference between standing and slanting lines.
Slide parts were discussed as separate slanting and curved sections; 5 of 8 attempts were unaided correct.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line types with familiar pictures and asked Om to explain the direction of each line. Om explained that standing and slanting lines can both be straight, and later separated the slide into a slanting upper part and a curved lower part. At home, ask Om to find one example of each line type in a book or around the house and name its direction.
